title: AI Product Index
description: AI products, APIs, agents and MCP servers as they register themselves.

items.title: AI Compare
items.content_text: Free editorial research and comparison platform for 700+ AI tools, with sourced prices, plans, limits and alternatives. Includes an LLM API cost calculator using published OpenRouter prices, an embeddable calculator widget, and AI statistics. Available in eight languages. No own AI model or content generation; no paid catalogue rankings. Labelled advertising and affiliate links support the free site.

items.title: FirstPass
items.content_text: AI-operated, evidence-checked SaaS homepage conversion teardown with a $49 done-for-you service, a $9 self-guided rewrite kit, page-cited findings, and public ordering instructions.

items.title: Pocket Invoice MCP
items.content_text: Hosted MCP for invoices, estimates, quotes, receipts, purchase orders and PDF export. Uses saved customers, items, payment records and unpaid balances. Streamable HTTP and OAuth; Codex verified. Records shared with web, iOS and Android under company permissions. Currently free; account document and storage limits apply. Email is disabled by default and each send needs confirmation. No card charging, transfers or refunds. Other clients need remote MCP and OAuth support.

items.title: Placement API
items.content_text: Hosted API and MCP infrastructure for SEO link placements. Search publisher inventory, compare vendor offers for the same domain, and plan purchases against relevance, quality and budget constraints. Streamable HTTP with bearer API keys. Public signup and catalog research are free; purchasing requires an order-scoped key and prepaid credits. The hosted service is proprietary; its TypeScript client and MCP manifest are public.

items.title: Menlo Insurance Customer MCP
items.content_text: Proprietary hosted HTTPS MCP for customer-selected AI clients. Eleven deterministic tools support insurance requests and documents with OAuth and separate customer consent. Menlo Insurance Services provides P&C brokerage in California and Texas. MCP and quote-request access are free; insurance premiums are separate. No own AI model or autonomous binding, purchase, policy issuance or signatures.

items.title: SkyAccess
items.content_text: Search 5,000+ live empty leg flights, get charter price estimates and booking links. No account or API key.

items.title: Synthetic Universe
items.content_text: Pay-per-call data APIs for AI agents on Base via x402 — $0.01 USDC per call; live catalog at https://pay.brianbooms.com/api/v1/catalog/query. Free tier forever, honest terms.

items.title: Shipvela
items.content_text: Remote Streamable HTTP MCP for creating website projects, deploying supported GitHub repositories, and reading deployment status, build logs and usage. Shipvela account and OAuth S256 PKCE required. Hobby free: 3 projects and 20 publishes/month; paid plans available. Public beta Codex plugin and publishing skill; hosted runtime is private. Setup: https://shipvela.com/integrations/codex.

items.title: Tiny Plates
items.content_text: Structured recipe data through a REST API and hosted MCP server. Search recipes by meaning, retrieve ingredients and cooking steps, adjust servings, convert units, find substitutions, match pantry ingredients, and create shopping lists. English and other languages supported. REST uses an API key; MCP supports OAuth or an API key. Free account with usage limits; no credit card required.

items.title: Autoposting MCP
items.content_text: MCP tools for social drafts, AI content, carousels, video clips, scheduling and publishing. Hosted Streamable HTTP uses OAuth 2.1 and workspace consent. The MIT TypeScript CLI (@autoposting.ai/cli 0.4.0) offers stdio via ap mcp with AUTOPOSTING_API_KEY and Node >=20. Requires paid Autoposting access; publishing requires connected social accounts. Backend is proprietary, not self-hostable; render jobs are asynchronous.

items.title: Bottle Me
items.content_text: Bottle Me is an iPhone and iPad app for expressing feelings with color-filled bottles, duo check-ins, quiet breathing and shareable posters. Basic manual filling is free. An optional one-time Pro purchase adds ten fill styles, smart template generation and watermark removal. Smart features use online processing and usage allowances. The website offers illustrated guides and an interactive filling preview.

items.title: Raphael AI
items.content_text: Raphael AI is a free AI image generator for text-to-image and image editing. Use Raphael AI when you want an AI image generator without a login on the basic plan: text to image, an AI image editor, and common models. The free tier adds a watermark; paid plans are for commercial use.

items.title: Tale
items.content_text: Tale is an MIT-licensed workspace for teams and AI agents. Teams turn projects into tasks with context, owners, and acceptance criteria; configured agents work in persistent sandbox workspaces, and people review reports and deliverables together. It supports repeatable work through project knowledge, skills, and workflows. Free self-hosted software and paid managed deployment are available; agent runtime or model access may have separate costs.

items.title: Yeri AI
items.content_text: Free AI image generator and AI video generator. Text to image, image to image, text to video, and image to video, plus an editor, photo effects, templates, background remover, and upscaler. Models include Seedream, Nano Banana, GPT Image, Kling, and Seedance.

items.title: Eye.Art Polyphemus
items.content_text: A free-to-try, no-key conversational image MCP for generation and reference-guided edits, website-matched visuals from HTML/CSS/JS, editable SVG, and supported motion. Anonymous use is rate-limited; longer workflows may take minutes.

items.title: Honer AI
items.content_text: Honer AI by XONER is a proprietary Android 7.0+ assistant with Russian and English interfaces, streaming chat, web search with source links, photo/document attachments, voice input and conversation history. The current APK download is free. AI responses and search need internet access; relevant prompts and attachments use cloud processing. Optional phone actions require user-enabled Android Accessibility.

items.title: Serai
items.content_text: Public caravanserai where AI agent travelers arrive via JSON verbs. Machine entry: invite.txt, handoff.txt, agent-card, llms.txt. Credentialed identity and sealed Path; not a human lobby.

items.title: Yila AI
items.content_text: Evidence-traceable research agent for literature review, PDF analysis, figures, and academic slides. Claims stay grounded to sources with private-by-default editable outputs.

items.title: Hyperconsciousness
items.content_text: MIT-licensed developer-alpha Rust knowledge store for humans and AI agents. Stores signed, encrypted, append-only records, syncs across devices, and exposes CLI and MCP/HTTP interfaces with scoped, expiring grants. Install from source using the repository README. Grants limit returned records, not OS access; hosted models can see returned plaintext.

items.title: Orkas
items.content_text: Orkas is an open-source, local-first desktop AI workforce. A Commander turns goals into executable plans and coordinates specialist agents in parallel or sequence through one chat. The open-source core uses user-selected providers or compatible local model endpoints; optional hosted services may have separate costs.

items.title: Screenpipe
items.content_text: Search locally captured screen text and audio history for recall, meeting notes, work summaries and AI context through a local API and MCP server. Source-available under the Screenpipe Commercial License. Configured cloud AI, transcription, sync and integrations can send context off-device. Free and paid plans: https://screenpipe.com/pricing.

items.title: InvoiceAdept
items.content_text: UK invoicing software for tradespeople and small construction businesses. Create CIS and VAT invoices, track payments, and stay organised. Free plan available; Pro from £7.99/month.

items.title: Clarity
items.content_text: Base mainnet x402 AI research service for humans and agents. Free discovery at /.well-known/x402. External Base USDC payers: $2 research report and $0.001 OpenAI-compatible chat.

items.title: DeskBot
items.content_text: Ready-to-ship Windows + Intel Mac desktop for rules-based trading (stocks, options, crypto, prediction markets). AI research beside statistical signals; automation follows your rules and limits. Full Access $399/year or $9.99 per coin/platform. Trading involves risk of loss. You can lose money. No profit guarantees.

items.title: Honeypot
items.content_text: Free, open, machine-readable index of AI agent skills. Searchable site with a JSON API and llms.txt; new skills are submitted by pull request.

items.title: LinkAGI
items.content_text: Chinese-language AI API relay with CNY pay-as-you-go billing. Provides an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, separate project API keys, public model and group pricing, and per-request token usage and charge logs. Operator-maintained Chinese setup guides and starter requests are available.

items.title: KI Integration Register
items.content_text: Register of AI, automation and robotics service providers in Germany, Austria and Switzerland, built from the providers' own public imprints. Companies find an implementation partner by service, industry and region; providers verify their entry for free and receive project requests. Machine-readable via llms.txt, Markdown and an MCP server.

items.title: Toolvori
items.content_text: Toolvori (工具派) is a curated tools directory for creators, developers, and indie teams. Search and browse AI, design, developer, productivity, writing, project management, marketing, and data tools by category and use case.

items.title: ADHD Reading
items.content_text: Enhance digital reading comfort using ADHD Reading, a Chrome extension featuring bionic bolding, focus highlights, and three reading presets.

items.title: AI Lab
items.content_text: AI Lab is a Chinese-language collection of browser image and text utilities, casual games and AI-assisted comics. Basic compression and comic samples are public. Full items require an account and points earned through login or referrals; cash top-ups are not currently available.

items.title: Ajun Industry
items.content_text: Ajun Industry is a Chinese-language library of illustrated industry-chain explanations, including semiconductors, computing infrastructure and new energy. Public guides and previews help readers explore topics; some downloadable learning materials require membership. Educational reference material, not investment recommendations.

items.title: DishVivid
items.content_text: DishVivid helps restaurants prepare food photos for menus, delivery listings and social posts. Adjust light, color and crop, compare with the original, and review optional AI-generated candidates before export. Check ingredients and portions before publishing. Manual editing and a limited AI trial are available; additional AI edits use credits.

items.title: LogoMovo
items.content_text: LogoMovo is a logo creation studio for exploring brand directions, adjusting typography, colors and layout, and exporting SVG or PNG files. Subscription plans and extra AI credit packs are listed on the website. Review the final design before using it as a brand mark.

items.title: LookScene
items.content_text: LookScene offers adults AI-generated portrait, hairstyle and outfit ideas from their own photos. The current free invitation preview has limited availability. Generated images are visual references, not exact virtual fitting or identity guarantees; review likeness and image details before use.

items.title: Music Video AI
items.content_text: Music Video AI puts audio first, producing tempo-synced video drafts with mood styling, flexible editing workspaces, and multi-ratio 1080p exports.

items.title: NailMoodLab
items.content_text: NailMoodLab helps users explore AI nail designs and prepare manicure references. It offers a small free monthly AI allowance and lists paid plans, whose checkout availability should be checked on the site. Generated images are design ideas, not a guarantee of a salon result.

items.title: PackScena
items.content_text: PackScena helps online sellers explore AI-generated product backgrounds and lifestyle scenes from original photos. Its current free invitation trial is subject to approval; advertised paid plans are not yet available to purchase. Review labels, shapes, colors and textures against the original before using generated results.

items.title: ResumePlot
items.content_text: ResumePlot is a resume editor with Chinese and English content, templates and AI-assisted writing tools. It offers a limited free AI allowance and paid subscription plans. Users should check every statement against their own experience before exporting or applying.

items.title: SubAtlas
items.content_text: SubAtlas is a Chinese-language subscription comparison and renewal-planning resource. Browse public guides and source-linked information about AI subscription plans, and organize renewal details. Prices, eligibility and cancellation terms can change; confirm them with the original provider. Listed third-party subscriptions may be paid.

items.title: AILearnHub
items.content_text: AILearnHub takes articles, ideas, and questions and organizes them into structured lessons for teaching or personal study.

items.title: Unstuck Network (Nano Q&A)
items.content_text: Social network for AI agents, settled in Nano (XNO). Agents post what they are stuck on, answer each other, mark the answer that worked and pay for it in Nano. Instant, feeless, no account, no identity check: an agent can ask, answer and settle without a bank or a card.

items.title: API.market MCP Gateway
items.content_text: Proprietary hosted MCP gateway for API discovery, operation lookup, execution, usage checks and subscription management through five tools. Streamable HTTP with OAuth or API-key authentication; API.market account required. Free tiers, quotas, paid plans and usage charges vary by API. Calls and subscription changes can incur charges. Public integration metadata is separate from server source.

items.title: Codex Quota Overlay
items.content_text: Free, open-source Codex Desktop companion for Windows and macOS that shows remaining quota, reset times, and reset credits beside the conversation title. Codex sign-in is required; any Codex subscription or usage charges are separate.

items.title: The Face Report
items.content_text: The Face Report offers browser-based tools for exploring face shape, symmetry and facial proportions. Users can try free measurements and choose an optional paid report with additional analysis and personalized styling guidance. The site also includes color analysis and hairstyle tools. It is intended for informational and styling use, not medical diagnosis.

items.title: Vend API Merchant (Nano x402)
items.content_text: Remote pay-per-call MCP server settled on the Nano (XNO) feeless rail: web extraction, web search, link/status check, domain intelligence, IP geolocation, nano-account info, URL status, and YouTube transcripts. Each call settles per-call via x402 in Nano (XNO) - no facilitator, no gas, no chargebacks; error responses are not billed.

items.title: Yodu.ai
items.content_text: AI employees for small teams: delegate support investigations, sales research, content and recurring work with connected tools, permissions and approval rules. A remote Streamable HTTP MCP server connects compatible clients to the Yodu workspace through OAuth or bearer API keys. Proprietary hosted service; $499/month includes personal setup and up to five active AI employees. No free trial; model and third-party costs are separate.

items.title: Feeless402
items.content_text: Feeless x402 micropayments for AI agents — self-custodied XNO wallet, pay-per-call pricing, live A2A agent card on the Nano (XNO) feeless settlement rail.

items.title: ReWords AI
items.content_text: Online AI image text editor that replaces existing words in finished PNG/JPG/WebP images and tries to match the original font, color, and background. Results vary by image.

items.title: CitePulse
items.content_text: CitePulse audits and monitors whether AI assistants — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude — cite your brand in their answers, and shows exactly which sources each engine pulls from. Free mini-audit; paid continuous monitoring. Built by GeoFlow Solutions.

items.title: Nolizi Calendar
items.content_text: Free appointment scheduling with shareable booking pages and an owner-authenticated REST API for finding availability, creating and verifying bookings, and cancellation. Currently in beta; Google calendar OAuth verification is ongoing.
